spans.s: लट् vt. or vi. 1P (pres. लटति) 1. To be young, to be a child; 2. to talk like a child, to prattle; 3. to cry.
लट m. 1. A fool, a blockhead; 2. a fault; 3. a thief.
लट्ट n. A rogue, a rascal.
लाट (I) m. pl. Name of a country and its people, लाटजनवल्लभत्वाच्च लाटानुप्रासः K.Pr.ix.
लाट (II) m. 1. A king of the Laṭas; 2. clothes in general; 3. worn out clothes; 4. childish language.
लटक m. A rogue, a rascal, a contemptible person.
लाटक a. (f. टिका) Relating to Laṭas.

लटभ a. (f. भा) This word is found no where in the existing dictionaries, but is used thrice or four times by Bilhaṇa in his Vikramānkadevacharita and once by Bhartṛhari. We are inclined to believe that it is the original Sanskrit word from which the Prākṛt लडह is derived. Of course, it is possible that the Sanskrit लटभ may have been consciously derived from the Prākṛt by the ordinary rules. It means ‘pretty, handsome, attractive,’ तस्याः पादनखश्रेणिः शोभते लटभभ्रुवः Vikr.Ch.viii.6, अतिक्रांतः कालो लटभललनाभोगसुलभः Bhartr.iii.32.

लट्व m. 1. a horse; 2. a dancing boy.
लट्वा f. 1. A kind of musical instrument; 2. a curl on the forehead; 3. a sparrow; 4. safflower; 5. an unchaste woman.

लाट-अनुप्रास m. a kind of alliteration consisting in the repetition of words in the same sense but in a different application, (शाब्दस्तु लाटानुप्रासो भेदे तात्पर्यमात्रतः K.Pr.ix.). The following may be cited as an example- यस्य न सविधे दयिता दवदहनस्तुहिनदीधितिस्तस्या यस्य च सविधे दयिता दवदहनस्तुहिनदीधितिस्तस्य K.Pr.ix.
लाटक a. (f. टिका) Relating to Laṭas.
लाटिका f. 1. A particular style of composition, S.D.ix.; 2. name of a Prākṛt dialect, K.D.i.35.
